preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 3 <= N <= 10**3 for each N in test cases
preconditions.description: Each test case's N must be between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The sum of all N values across test cases must not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**18 for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Every element in the output array A must be an integer between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == N for N in test_cases
postconditions.description: The output array A must have exactly N elements for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(1 <= i <= N, 2 <= len(S) <= N, math.gcd(*S) == i) for S in subsequences(A)) for i in range(1, N+1))
postconditions.description: For every integer i from 1 to N, there must exist at least one subsequence S of A with length between 2 and N such that the GCD of all elements in S equals i.
